author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Based off of Super Mario 64, Bob-omb Battlefield is a map for Kingship utilizing resource packs, and a two-team based game where you have to eliminate a single king. You are paired with other teammates to destroy just the one king at the top of the hill, and there are other optimizations that may come to the gamemode.

Some of these optimizations include:
- Chests around the map spawning in gear to help
- Possible bow-and-sword based kits for player preference
- More features provided in the Mario 64 version (flying around the map, teleportation)
  - Teleportation is available in the mountain to both kings and players
- Ability to collect items similar to stars to gain better gear/rewards (like break the logs)

This is not the only Kingship map that may arrive. This is a completely new standard for Arcade and contains a PvP gamemode that is completely unique to Avicus, where you may have side objectives to reward you as you try to take claim to kill the king and work with others in this teamwork oriented game. It's fast, fun, and above all, creative. This game is in development. Credit to eXiggah for the original map (I would consider this a remix, but it's for testing)

I'm pleased to announce the first map, Bob-omb Battlefield (the next map that will come may be a Banjo-Kazooie map: Spiral Mountain) with spawns around the sides. I am in a large Nintendo 64 phase and would love to introduce maps from older games and repurpose them.

http://imgur.com/a/9EGrf
